description: Defines a custom vector class 'FatVector' with inline storage optimization, including a custom allocator 'InlineStdAllocator'. Implements a vector with preallocated internal buffer to avoid malloc overhead for small sizes.

classes.name: InlineStdAllocator
classes.description: A custom allocator that uses a fixed-size inline buffer for small allocations and falls back to malloc for larger ones.

classes.name: FatVector
classes.description: A std::vector subclass with a small internal buffer to optimize for small sizes.

methods.name: allocate
methods.description: Allocates memory either from the inline buffer or via malloc.

methods.name: deallocate
methods.description: Deallocates memory, returning it to the inline buffer or freeing it.

methods.name: FatVector()
methods.description: Default constructor that reserves space for SIZE elements.

methods.name: FatVector(std::initializer_list<T> init)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes vector with a list and reserves space.

methods.name: FatVector(size_t capacity)
methods.description: Constructor that resizes the vector to the specified capacity.
